carter: Quick drop-in policy question 1: I'm drafting a proposal for export-safe SIEM feeds and timeboxed unwraps. High-level: short full-detail window, then metadata-only for longer retention. Need to lock down the KMS unwrap pattern and RBAC controls.

meera: +1. Clarify: separate retention windows for human-admin vs service accounts? Forensics value differs.

carter: Yes plan: human-admin full 30d, user auth 14d, service-account 7d. After that, compute hashes and keep only metadata for 1y, then archive minimal record for 7y.

derek: For exports -> use an export-proxy that copies filtered events to an export bucket encrypted with an ephemeral data key. Wrap that key with our CMK and emit a one-time unwrap token tied to the JIRA ticket and TTL. No raw exports without ticket.

olivia: Require a second approver for TTL >24h and require a justification string. Also mandate a redaction_profile selection (PII/PCI/None).

sec-bot: reminder: any export operation must include a ticket id and attach runbook reference per policy.

meera: Implementation question: rewrap per-export vs per-ticket envelope key? Per-ticket envelope seems easier to audit.

derek: Agreed. Flow: 1) request auth via OPA 2) proxy writes filtered objects encrypted with ephemeral key 3) wrap ephemeral key with CMK and store wrap-metadata with ticket id 4) generate unwrap token for approver with TTL. Audit logs: requester, approver, ticket, unwrap-token-id, TTL.

olivia: Add legal-hold behavior: legal can mark ticket/export immutable; unwrap tokens must be revocable and we should log revocation events. Also include emergency-bypass: short TTL (1h), auto-notify legal/CISO, and tamper-evident audit entry.

carter: I'll write a short RFC: retention matrix, export-proxy config sample, RBAC-change template, and emergency playbook. Please review by Thu EOD.

derek: I'll add sequence diagram and minimal config snippet.

meera: I'll collect vuln-triage cases that need raw headers so we can define timeboxed retrieval templates.

olivia: I'll draft the RBAC template + example justification language for auditors.

carter: Draft config snippet I mocked: ```yaml
export:
  ticket_required: true
  secondary_approver_threshold_hours: 24
  mask_default: true
  redaction_profile: "general"
  allowed_principals: ["human-admin","security-incident"]
  ephemeral_key_ttl_seconds: 3600
  audit_store: "kms-wrap-metadata"
```

carter: Thanks all :thumbsup: will post RFC link when ready.
